page_title: NEW 0-2 AST | Newcastle v Aston Villa 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' One of the Aston Villa players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90+5' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Here comes a substitution. Victor Lindelof (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Amadou Onana.
88' 0 - 2 Goal! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) makes the score 0:2 after burying a close-range header low in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Lucas Digne.
87' Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.

87' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
84' Substitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) replaces Sandro Tonali.
82' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the top of the net, but Nick Pope denies him.
81' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 7:11.
80' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Aston Villa, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
79' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
78' Emiliano Martinez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
78' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Now Newcastle have a corner.
75' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Emiliano Buendia and he is replaced by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) for Pau Torres.
74' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch because Youri Tielemans simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
74' The percentage of ball possession is – 61:39.
70' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' The corner is swung in but Newcastle can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
65' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
63' The game has come to an end for Anthony Gordon. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd).
62' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) replacing Yoane Wissa.
62' The corner from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is hurriedly cleared.
61' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
59' Substitution. Jadon Sancho did his best and is replaced by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa).
58' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).

56' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
55' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is first to react to a great cross from Harvey Barnes, but slices his shot high over the bar from inside the box.
53' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and it's Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
51' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Emiliano Martinez has no trouble gathering it.
51' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
48' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is substituted due to injury. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Jacob Ramsey.
47' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save.
45+4' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sends it out of play.
45+3' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Emiliano Martinez makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the top left corner by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) after a cross from the side.
42' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
39' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to feed Yoane Wissa with a chip pass, but Emiliano Martinez reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
38' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
38' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:6.
35' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Nick Pope stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
32' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
30' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
28' The game is interrupted now, Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' What was Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
24' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Matty Cash (Aston Villa) inside the box.
22' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement.
19' 0 - 1 Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) struck from medium range. He smashed the ball inside the left post. What a hit! Pure magic.
16' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
13' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
11' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
10' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

5' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Nick Pope!
4' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

1' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Emiliano Martinez thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
1' The first half has just begun.

Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Emiliano Martinez, who pulls off a comfortable save!
The players are out at last! Newcastle will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will supervise the game today.
